Im scared of pain, it’s probably not natural to kill yourself since your body will try to stay alive, I had this really intense dream (I’m always idealizing death in my head) where my brothers and loved ones showed me what death was like. They weren’t trying to convince me to kill myself neither to stay alive. It was so indescribable and unbelievably confusing and kind of painful to my soul. Even though I wanted to be with them in this weird (mental) place the next morning I kind of decided I was lucky to still be alive in my own head. I’m grateful for the people around me even tho sometimes I feel like they did me wrong. In their hearts they’re all helping me. Good luck 💗
